answer: Proof-of-stake consensus functions as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism by mandating capital commitment rather than ephemeral identities. To forge multiple identities, an attacker must acquire significant native tokens, which renders a hollow network economically infeasible to manipulate. Validators ensure that each transaction is not merely an echo of prior noise but a cryptographically verified action, forcing adversaries to incur substantial financial risk for any attempt at network subversion.
